ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and transactional counterparts against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions Targets, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit domestic designations. PEP status triggers senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, and ongoing transaction monitoring. For a low-risk standard tier goods manufacturer (handmade epoxy resin dice) using Kickstarter/Stripe and PayPal settlement rails, enhanced scrutiny applies to crowdfunding volume spikes, cross-border charity-linked payouts, and high-risk payment corridor flags. Screening must be performed at onboarding, prior to each disbursement, and on a continuous real-time basis via a licensed screening provider.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies - Companies e-Registry portal (roc.gov.bm); parallel trade name availability check under Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 where the company will hold a Gibraltar establishment.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English characters only; no local script transliteration is required. The name must end with a statutory corporate identifier: Limited, Ltd., Incorporated, or Inc. The name must be distinguishable from all existing registered names, must not be misleading as to activity or asset base, and must not imply Crown, government, or regulatory sponsorship.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant receives a written ground from the Registrar of Companies. The applicant may file a reconsideration letter with the Registrar within 28 days, attaching a business description and demonstrating the proposed name is distinctive and not misleading. If reconsideration is refused, the applicant may immediately submit a new name application without penalty. A rejected applicant may also seek judicial review before the Bermuda Supreme Court on limited procedural grounds. Parallel Gibraltar filings under the Companies Act 2014 remain independent and may be re-submitted at any time.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office. A Bermuda Exempted Company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda through a licensed corporate service provider under the Corporate Service Provider Business Act 2001. Virtual-only offices do not satisfy the statutory mandate; however, remote board meetings and Gibraltar-based operational management are permitted, provided the Bermuda registered office remains staffed and accessible during business hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 5-10% annual probability of unannounced inspection for a non-financial, low-risk goods manufacturer. Inspections are triggered by crowdfunding volume anomalies, sanctions screening hits, or failure to file the annual economic substance declaration, rather than routine sweeps. Bermuda and Gibraltar authorities coordinate under the UK-Gibraltar framework only on material AML irregularities.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2014 (Gibraltar), as amended; Part II, ss. 8-20 (incorporation and certificate of incorporation); Part IV, ss. 51-58 (directors, secretary and registered office); s. 84 (written resolutions); Income Tax (Exempt Companies) Regulations 2010 and the Income Tax Act 2010 for exempted-company status election.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry, HM Government of Gibraltar, 6/3 Line Wall Road, Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form GIB-INC-01 'Application to Register a Private Company Limited by Shares', together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association and the statutory Declaration of Compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is imposed. The exempted-company structure may issue no-par-value shares; an initial issued share capital of one ordinary share is sufficient. No escrow deposit or bank verification is required before incorporation, although subscription consideration may be held in the registered agent's client money account pending issuance of the certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscriber share allotment of 1,000 no-par-value ordinary shares is approved and allotted to the founding member for a subscription consideration of USD 1,000, such consideration to be released only after the Certificate of Incorporation is issued. (2) The registered office is established at the address specified in the registered agent's consent, and the registered agent is appointed to keep all statutory registers. (3) [Name] is appointed as first director and [Name] as company secretary, each consenting to act. (4) The director and secretary are jointly authorized to make all statutory filings, elect exempted-company tax status, and open bank, Stripe and PayPal accounts. Passed unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry, HM Government of Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed corporate name containing the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and verify that it does not conflict with the Gibraltar companies index or any Gibraltar trade mark. File Form GIB-NR01 through the Companies Registry e-portal to reserve the name for 28 days.
required_dossiers: Form GIB-NR01 — Application for Reservation of a Company Name
Identity document of the subscriber and beneficial owner
Business scope declaration referencing ISIC 3240 and tabletop gaming accessories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as misleading or too similar to an existing name, submit an alternative distinctive name within three business days or provide a letter of consent from the objecting entity for continued use.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Notary Public and appointed corporate services provider, in coordination with the Gibraltar Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association using the statutory model articles, with bespoke objects covering the design, casting, finishing and distribution of sharp-edge epoxy resin liquid core polyhedral dice. Include the exempted-company declarations and limited-liability provisions. Have each subscriber execute the instruments before a notary public.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Capital and Initial Shareholdings
Statutory Declaration of Compliance
Consent of First Registered Office and Registered Agent
Passport copies and proof of residential address of each subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects any constitutional clause as inconsistent with the Companies Act, amend and re-notarize the instruments within seven days and resubmit with a marked-up comparison chart.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the completed Form GIB-INC-01 together with the notarized constitutional documents and statutory consent forms. Pay the official state filing fee using the accepted payment methods. Retain the electronic acknowledgement receipt.
required_dossiers: Form GIB-INC-01 — Application to Register a Company Limited by Shares
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Capital
Statutory Declaration of Compliance
Consent of First Director, Secretary and Registered Office
Filing fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any query from the Registrar within fourteen working days. If the application is deficient, resubmit a corrected application together with an explanatory letter; no additional filing fee is payable if the correction is made before the deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Company Number Allocation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry, HM Government of Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar performs statutory verification, allocates the unique Gibraltar company number, affixes the official seal to the Certificate of Incorporation, and registers the Memorandum and Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: Issued Certificate of Incorporation
Official company number notice
Stamped and filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any clerical error appears on the Certificate of Incorporation, return it to the Registry with the incorporation file reference and a certified request for administrative rectification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and registered agent of the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the statutory first board meeting in accordance with the Articles of Association. Pass the pro-forma first board resolution, adopt the registers of members, directors, secretary and persons with significant control, allot shares, and issue share certificates.
required_dossiers: Notice of First Board Meeting
Pro-forma First Board Resolution
Share subscription and allotment sheets
Consent to act of each director and secretary
Register of members, directors, secretary, PSC and charges
Share certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum is not achieved, adjourn the meeting for 48 hours; alternatively, pass the resolution as a unanimous written resolution signed by all directors and members under section 84 of the Companies Act 2014.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Exempted-Status Election and Banking Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office; Gibraltar Financial Services Commission-regulated bank or electronic money institution; Gibraltar Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Gibraltar tax registration form with the Certificate of Incorporation, elect exempted-company status under the relevant regulations, complete the AML/KYC process for the bank account, and attach the Stripe and PayPal settlement routes to the company's operating accounts.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Tax Registration Form GIB-TR1
Exempted Company Status Election Form
First Board Resolution and banking mandate
Director and shareholder KYC documentation
Payment rails operating agreement for Kickstarter, Stripe and PayPal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the exempted-status election or tax registration is queried, provide a full non-residence beneficial-ownership schedule and an economic substance statement before the appeal deadline to the Income Tax Appeals Tribunal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Development and Planning Commission, Industrial Premises Licensing Section
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Activity Operating Permit for Micro-Manufacture and Resin Casting Premises under the Development and Planning Act and the Factories and Workshops Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: HM Government of Gibraltar, Department of Environment, Heritage and Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Scheduled Small-Scale Activity — Mandatory Environmental Registration; Exempt from Full EIA Report under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations because installed resin-casting capacity is below 25,000 dice units per annum and volatile organic compound usage is below 5 tonnes per annum.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Air emissions: process exhaust VOCs not exceeding 50 mg/m3; benzene below 0.05 mg/m3; workplace TWA for epoxy-resin dust below 1 mg/m3. Wastewater: no process wastewater discharge to public sewer; if any discharge occurs, pH must be 6.0-9.0, BOD5 below 300 mg/L and suspended solids below 60 mg/L. Hazardous waste: uncured epoxy resin, catalysts and rejected sharp-edge dice must be segregated, stored in UN-rated containers and consigned to an authorized waste carrier; no disposal into municipal waste streams.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service confirming means of escape, flame-retardant storage cabinets for resin and catalyst materials, and emergency lighting; Building Control structural load assessment for curing racks and production fixtures; workplace clearance under the Safety at Work Regulations, including local exhaust ventilation testing and a documented personal protective equipment regime.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, Income Tax Office, HM Government of Gibraltar; official e-services are accessed through the Government of Gibraltar Taxation Portal, with CRS/FATCA filings submitted through the Gibraltar Reporting System (GRS).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Bermuda Exempted Company with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies (no minimum capital required; Certificate of Exemption obtained). Step 2: If a place of business is established in Gibraltar, register the foreign company with Gibraltar Companies House under the Companies Act 2014. Step 3: Apply to the Commissioner of Income Tax on the prescribed corporate registration form to obtain the Gibraltar Tax Identification Number, disclosing registered office, directors, beneficiaries, and UBO particulars. Step 4: Register with HM Customs Gibraltar for a customs trader identification code when importing or exporting goods. Step 5: Register under GRS for CRS/FATCA automatic exchange and ensure compliance with the Beneficial Ownership Register filing. Step 6: Assess any UK VAT registration requirement arising from UK-based sales activity or stock-holding.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope : A non-resident Bermuda-incorporated company is taxable in Gibraltar only on profits arising in or derived from Gibraltar; a Bermuda Exempted Company is separately within Tax_Exempt_Zone treatment in Bermuda, where no income or capital gains tax applies and only an annual government fee is payable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar does not operate a check-the-box election. Available mechanisms include: advance tax ruling requests to the Commissioner of Income Tax regarding territorial scope and rate; group relief election for Gibraltar-resident group companies; hybrid mismatch notification and adjustment elections under the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2019; and transfer pricing contemporaneous documentation elections, including an option for a unilateral or bilateral advance pricing agreement.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Import Duty and Excise Duty. Gibraltar has no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; under Protocol 3 of the Treaty of Accession, Gibraltar is outside the EU VAT area and does not charge VAT on goods or services supplied in its territory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable, as no VAT/GST regime exists. Any importer of goods must register with HM Customs Gibraltar for a customs trader identification code with no de minimis turnover threshold; import duty is assessed per the UK-Gibraltar customs arrangement under the relevant tariff classification, with polyhedral tabletop dice typically classified under HS heading 9504.90 and frequently attracting a zero or low positive duty rate depending on origin and applicable trade preference.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Gibraltar does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls, certified e-invoicing, SII, or digital stamping. Export and import declarations are filed electronically through the UK Customs Declaration Service or CHIEF, while commercial B2B and B2C invoicing remains in standard free-format electronic or paper form.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable in Gibraltar because the jurisdiction levies no VAT or sales tax; therefore no 0% export VAT claim or refund mechanism exists. Exports of epoxy resin dice from Gibraltar are outside the scope of any Gibraltar consumption tax, while UK import VAT, if any, is accounted for by the UK buyer at the border. No Gibraltar indirect tax is chargeable on either local retail supply or outward export supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (submitted via the UK Customs Declaration Service applicable to Gibraltar departures)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Commercial Invoice describing the sharp-edge epoxy resin liquid core dice and HS classification
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 evidence of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback can arise as no VAT is charged. Customs audit scrutiny applies to export declarations, duty drawback, and transit reliefs; false or incomplete declarations may trigger forfeiture of goods, monetary penalties of up to three times the value of the goods, suspension of the customs trader code, and director personal liability under Gibraltar customs legislation. Where export proceeds are not remitted within the 180-day benchmark, the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit expects the payment institution to apply enhanced due diligence and potentially file a Suspicious Activity Report; trade mis-invoicing schemes may additionally attract prosecution under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) is the licensing and supervisory authority for Gibraltar banks; H.M. Government of Gibraltar (Financial Secretary, as Currency Commissioner) issues Gibraltar pounds at a statutory 1:1 peg to GBP; the Bank of England sets monetary policy for the underlying sterling; the Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) supervises the Bermuda Exempted Company and issues the Certificate of Compliance required for Gibraltar onboarding.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility, current and capital account. No Gibraltar or UK exchange-control statute restricts purchases, sales, or remittances in GBP, USD, EUR, or GIP. Trade settlements, service fees, and marketplace sweeps move freely without pre-authorisation. Profit remittance (dividend, capital reduction, or repayable shareholder loan) faces no FX hurdle and no Gibraltar withholding tax; the bank will expect board minutes, CRS self-certification, and evidence that Bermuda tax-exempt status does not create a sham permanent-establishment exposure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Gibraltar and the United Kingdom impose no export-proceeds surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no requirement to repatriate export receipts. The company may retain 100% of proceeds in any currency, in any jurisdiction, indefinitely. The only binding obligations are documentary: retain underlying invoices, bills of lading, and marketplace settlement reports for at least five years under the GFSC AML/CTF Directions, and accept the transacting bank's ITRS aggregate statistical reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banco Santander Totta S.A., Gibraltar Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High as a settlement sub-rail, Low as a primary banker. UK-licensed EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Revolut Business) no longer passport into Gibraltar after Brexit, and automated EMI platforms typically auto-decline a Bermuda-incorporated applicant. Practical model: open the GFSC-licensed core account at NatWest or Santander, then attach Wise Business or Airwallex as an agency collection account for Stripe/PayPal USD/EUR flows. Legal constraint: the EMI cannot be the audit-relevant 'bank'—Gibraltar-regulated auditors require statutory books and operating liquidity to reside at a GFSC-licensed credit institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De facto mandatory. NatWest and Santander require at least one director or authorised signatory to attend in person at a Gibraltar branch for wet-ink execution and biometric identity verification; Barclays requires all substantive directors to appear. Jyske Bank permits fully remote onboarding through a notarised identity pack, a live video interview, and a Gibraltar-licensed fiduciary 'professional introducer' certificate. Remote opening is bank discretion rather than a statutory right; an offshore-incorporated applicant may be declined without reasons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore corporate nexus: Bermuda Exempted Company registered in Gibraltar as an external company, with no visible place of business or staff in either territory.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing dated within three months; Bermuda public beneficial-ownership extract; Gibraltar Companies (Foreign Companies) Act registration certificate; notarised board resolution appointing a Gibraltar-resident registered agent; Bermuda Economic Substance Act filing or pure-holding exemption statement; current UBO declaration; 12 months of source-of-funds statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Crowdfunding inflow spike: Kickstarter pre-sale receipts (GBP/USD/EUR 200k–500k) arriving in a single 30-day tranche, creating a burst-and-burn profile inconsistent with the declared low-risk micro trading model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kickstarter campaign terms and platform proof of funding; Stripe payout report; itemised production and fulfilment budget; supplier pro-forma invoices matched to the drawdown schedule; refund-policy disclosure; founder affidavit explaining pledge economics (gross pledges minus platform fees minus cost of goods); a bank-approved funds-release schedule aligned to the production plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Product misclassification: 'epoxy resin liquid core' may trigger transaction-monitoring flags for hazardous chemicals or cosmetic/tobacco-adjacent goods.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC 3240 and HS 9504.90 classification memo; epoxy resin supplier MSDS confirming a non-hazardous cured state; DHL/FedEx/UPS exemption letter releasing the goods from dangerous-goods declarations; product website screenshot and rulebook inserts confirming tabletop gaming dice; customs logs evidencing physical shipment to backers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: CRS/CFC ambiguity: a UK-resident founder/director controlling an offshore entity may trigger a Common Reporting Standard review or a UK CFC/close-company enquiry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CRS self-certifications for every individual controller; signed board minute fixing strategic management in Gibraltar/Bermuda consistently with the entity structure; UK residence summary for each director; licensed tax adviser's memorandum excluding the company from UK CFC AP or establishing an excluded-territory position; declaration that the Gibraltar registered agent performs only administrative functions, not management and control.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 from the founder's UK or US bank to the NatWest Gibraltar capital escrow account; wire narrative 'INITIAL SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION'; purpose code 'CAPT' or the bank-mandated equivalent. Pre-deliver to the relationship manager: board resolution authorising share allotment, imputed share certificate, 12 months of source-of-funds statements, BMA Certificate of Compliance, Gibraltar UBO declaration, and CRS self-certifications. The receiving bank applies OFAC/sanctions screening and may impose a funds-release schedule tied to the Kickstarter production budget.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Default clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 open-account T/T against supplier invoices, purpose code 'GDSM'/'S0101' (goods). Sight or 90-day commercial letters of credit are offered above approximately GBP 10,000, but micro-ticket supplier payments make documentary collection (D/P) the practical mid-tier option. Marketplace outflows: Stripe/PayPal USD/EUR settlements sweep to Wise, then concentrate via SWIFT to the NatWest Gibraltar GBP operating account, matched against platform payout statements to preserve a clean audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable GBP/USD forward contracts (tenors up to 12 months; notional up to GBP 250,000) executed under the bank-standard FX master agreement at NatWest or Santander.
FX swaps (USD/GBP and EUR/GBP) for same-day or next-day liquidity rebalancing between the Wise settlement account and the Gibraltar operating account.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) restricted to exotic supplier currencies without a deliverable onshore market (e.g., THB, PHP), transacted with a GFSC-licensed or Tier-1 international bank.
Cross-currency swaps: permissible in principle but commercially unavailable at micro-scale without an ISDA master; a rolling forward ladder replicates the same economic protection.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 12.5% (20% for regulated utilities, gaming and telecommunication providers)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket tax holiday; available preferential deductions include the 150% research and development super-deduction, the substantial shareholding participation exemption, and a 0% rate on capital gains from qualifying trading asset disposals.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form C – Gibraltar Company Annual Tax Return; eFiled through the Income Tax Office Electronic Filing Portal (https://efiling.gibraltar.gov.gi)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the chargeable accounting period; for a period ending on 31 December, the statutory due date is 31 December of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity identification: full company name, registration number, tax reference number and registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Bermuda Exempted Company's legal name and the Gibraltar branch registration number (Certificate of Compliance); use GRN 90000-GI branch prefix.
Use the start date of the Gibraltar PE's separate accounting period as reflected in the audited branch financial statements.
Use the PE accounting year-end; should align with the parent's financial year unless a statutory filing date forces a different cut-off.
Include all sales settled through Gibraltar-based payment collection accounts, including Kickstarter campaign pledges, Stripe processing and PayPal payouts attributable to the PE.
Attribution analysis required: allocate to Gibraltar only those profits arising from activities carried out by the fixed place of business under OECD Authorised OECD Approach (AOA).
Claim on plant and machinery physically located in Gibraltar (e.g., epoxy casting machinery, moulds, ventilation equipment); no claim for head-office assets.
Only losses of the same Gibraltar trade within the 5-year carryforward window may be deducted; Bermuda losses cannot be transferred.
Reconcile with the transfer pricing documentation; if the Bermuda parent has not adopted arm's-length remuneration for the PE, an upward assessment will be made.
Multiply adjusted profit by 12.5%; do not apply the 20% rate unless the branch derives regulated utility, telecom or gaming revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax liability, credits and payment due (GIP).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply any available unilateral foreign tax credit for income taxes paid in Bermuda, capped at the Gibraltar tax on the same income; pay the balance to the Commissioner.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late return: fixed GIP 100 penalty; daily surcharge of GIP 30 per day for up to 90 days; additional GIP 300 after 6 months and GIP 100 or 100% of tax due after 12 months; criminal prosecution for fraudulent returns under the Crimes Act 2011.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Gibraltar does not impose dividend withholding tax, whether to residents, Bermuda, UK, or other non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: As the direct shareholder is a Bermuda Exempted Company, no double tax treaty relief is required because Gibraltar imposes zero withholding tax. General protocol: for treaty-covered jurisdictions, a claim for reduced WHT is effected by submitting Form DTA-1 together with an original Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority within the last 6 months; the claim must reach the Gibraltar Income Tax Office before the relevant payment is settled.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and licence fees: statutory rate 0%; debt interest: statutory rate 0%; UK-Gibraltar arrangement applies a 0% rate on payments between UK and Gibraltar; no treaty with Bermuda so the domestic nil rate remains.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: GIP 1,000,000 aggregate controlled transactions for mandatory Local File; Master File required when the Gibraltar group is part of an MNE group with consolidated group revenue above GIP 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: 2019 Economic Substance Regulations apply to relevant activities (headquarters, distribution, service centre, pure holding, IP, financing, leasing and regulated financial activities). Manufacturing and sale of polyhedral dice do not constitute a relevant activity; however, the PE must still evidence regular board meetings, a physical notion of management in Gibraltar, and operational substance in line with OECD substance guidance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing online role-play dice sales through the Bermuda parent while the Gibraltar branch carries out actual production and customer support, thereby suppressing Gibraltar taxable profit; or fabricating purchase invoices from a fake resin supplier.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine not exceeding GIP 10,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 7 years under the Crimes Act 2011 s.190; civil penalty of up to 100% of the tax undercharged under Income Tax Act 2010.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of the Bermuda Exempted Company that knowingly cause the false filing are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax; the Supreme Court may issue a travel ban, asset restraint and director disqualification until the liability is liquidated.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Gibraltar post-office address only, with all high-level decisions made in Bermuda and no locally based director or payroll; using the Gibraltar branch as a conduit for Kickstarter, Stripe and PayPal flows without real local economic activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory strike-off of the Gibraltar overseas company registration; revocation of tax registration; reassessment under the 20% anti-abuse rate; penalty of up to GIP 500,000 under the Economic Substance Rules; possible court-ordered liquidation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally assessed for the entire landmarked profit under section 96 of the Income Tax Act, with a 15-year restriction on leaving Gibraltar and extradition to the UK for willful default.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Gibraltar settlement bank account for Kickstarter and PayPal receipts without filing a suspicious activity report; or privately using the payment rails to collect third-party crowdfunding funds in breach of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the payment account, fine up to GIP 2,000,000 and/or 14 years imprisonment; suspension or revocation of the Gibraltar financial services permission; referral to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow managers exiting Gibraltar may face personal criminal liability; a conviction triggers disqualification from directorships for 15 years, personal asset freezing, and denial of bail pending trial.
